|lore=Ubrikkian sail barge. Custom built for Jabba with an armored hull and weaponry. Top speed of 100 kph. Used by the Hutt crimelord on his many trips to Mos Eisley.
|game_text=May add 1 alien driver and 8 passengers. Your vehicle weapons deploy free aboard. Once per turn, may deploy Passenger Deck or a skiff here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While on Tatooine with a skiff, Force drain +1 here.

|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jabba's Sail Barge (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-jabbassailbarge-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-jabbassailbarge022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/jabbassailbarge.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/jabbassailbarge.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Jabba’s Sail Barge”. Text: “May add 1 alien driver and 8 passengers. Your vehicle weapons deploy free aboard. Once per turn, may deploy Passenger Deck or a skiff here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While on Tatooine with a skiff, Force drain +1 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jabba's Sail Barge (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-jabbassailbargee8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/jabbassailbarge.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/jabbassailbarge.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114015637/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch3-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Jabba’s Sail Barge” → “Jabba’s Sail Barge” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Jabba’s Sail Barge”. It is the current image. Text: “May add 1 alien driver and 8 passengers. Your vehicle weapons deploy free aboard. Once per turn, may deploy Passenger Deck or a skiff here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While on Tatooine with a skiff, Force drain +1 here.”
